strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Clears Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ You WILL be signed out of Google accounts (you must re-add them).
• Your photos and apps are untouched.
• The device reboots automatically after.

Are you sure?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Kutenga makiyi anzeru: imayang'ana bokosi lachinsinsi lomwe lilipo polimbana ndi mndandanda wa Google wochotsa (CRL) ndikuyesa magwero angapo mpaka itapeza bokosi loyenera, losunga zosunga zobwezeretsera ndikuyambiranso ntchito Google. Imathamanga pampopi iliyonse ndipo imafuna intaneti (1-3 mphindi).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox from network: downloads a keybox from the official repository (GitHub) and saves it to /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Needs internet and takes 1-3 minutes. Used when the smart fetch fails or when the keybox was changed manually.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP matenda: imayang'ana ma module a Remote Key Provisioning omwe alipo, kuyang'ana mtundu wa satifiketi ya TEE, ndikuwonetsa chida cha KmInstallKeybox. Sikusintha chilichonse - mawonekedwe osavuta a chipangizocho.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine fufuzani (kuwerenga-pokha): imasonyeza Widevine zizindikiro za mlingo (L1/L3) kuchokera ku dumpsys, DRM (IDM) kukhalapo kwa fayilo, ndi machitidwe ogwirizana nawo. Sikusintha kalikonse.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP kukonza: imayendetsa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh buku. Imakonza zovuta zotsimikizira ngati chiphaso cha automatic chikulephera. Kuthamanga kulikonse kumasindikiza mzere wowonekera bwino / wolephera.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP kukonza: imayendetsa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh yodzaza. Imasamalira milandu yovuta ndipo imatenga nthawi yayitali. Chotsatira chomveka chikuwonekera kumapeto.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Bwezeraninso GMS: imachotsa Play Store ndi Google ntchito (GMS+GSF) data ndikuyatsanso chipangizochi zokha. Kwa umboni wamakani okha - sichikhudza zithunzi kapena mafayilo anu.
strings.mdCertify: • Chitsimikizo cha Sewero: imayang'ana momwe chitsimikiziro cha RKP cha chipangizocho ndikukhazikitsanso zotsimikizira ngati zingafunike. Sichikhudza deta ya ogwiritsa ntchito.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER kukonza: kukonza Google chimango cha ntchito (SOTER) zokhudzana ndi umboni wa chipangizo. Amagwiritsidwa ntchito pazida zina zomwe zimadalira SOTER m'malo mwa Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF fufuzani: ikuwonetsa momwe injini yayikidwira, mafayilo a zala (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ndi zipika. Yang'anani kokha - sichisintha chilichonse.
strings.mdCanary: • Kusintha kwa Canary: kumayendetsa sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Imalandila kutulutsidwa kwaposachedwa kwa Canary Engine kuti muwonetsetse kuti ikugwirizana ndi ziphaso zovomerezeka RKP (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Kuzindikira kwa injini: imayang'ana TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), mafayilo a keybox (yogwira vs wosuta), zenizeni vs spoofed chipangizo chala, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP makiyi. Chiwonetsero cha matenda okha.
strings.hintKbSlots: Gawoli limayang'anira mipata iwiri ya makiyi: choyambirira (chopatulika, chosafufutidwa) ndi chachiwiri (zosunga zobwezeretsera). Tsambali likuwonetsa malo omwe akugwira ntchito, kusintha zomwe amakonda, kapena kulimbikitsa yachiwiri kupita ku pulayimale pofunsa mwachindunji - ndi zosunga zobwezeretsera ndi chipika chonse.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Kuzindikira kukhulupirika: imayang'ana TEE kulowetsa chinsinsi, jekeseni laibulale mkati mwa keystore2, malo ochotsedwa (CRL), mndandanda wa chitetezo ndi RKP state. Kuwerenga kokha - sikumasintha chilichonse.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Ikaninso motetezeka:

• Mndandanda wachitetezo umamangidwanso kuchokera ku pulogalamu iliyonse yomwe yayikidwa.
• Chigawo chogwirizana ndi mwambo-ROM chimagwiritsidwanso ntchito.
• Bokosi la kiyibodi likugwiritsidwanso ntchito.
• Google Play#00000000 yayambikanso6#000000 yayambikanso6#00000 yayambidwanso7#00000 yayambikanso6. primary keybox simakhudza konse.

Pitirizani?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Mipata ya makiyibodi: imawonetsa momwe mipata ya pulayimale ndi yachiwiri ilili ndikusintha zokonda pakati pawo. Choyambirira (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) chimatetezedwa nthawi zonse ndipo sichifafanizidwa. Kukweza yachiwiri mpaka pulaimale kumafuna chitsimikiziro chotsimikizika.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Kwezani kagawo kachiwiri kupita ku pulayimale:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml imakhala malo oyambira.
• Pulayimale yapano imasungidwa ngati yosunga zosunga zobwezeretsera isanalowe m'malo.
• Palibe chomwe chachotsedwa — opareshoniyo ndi yobwezedwa.

Pitilizani?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Chotsani kagawo kachiwiri:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml idzachotsedwa.
• Malo oyambira samakhudzidwa.

Pitirizani?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Tengani bokosi la kiyibodi pa intaneti:

• Kutsitsa bokosi la kiyibodi lovomerezeka ndikulitsimikizira.
• Yoyikika kotheratu (siyinabwezedwe pa boot).

⚠️ Imafunika intaneti (mpaka mphindi imodzi). Pitirizani?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Bwezeraninso RKP makiyi:

• Palibe deta kapena mafayilo a keybox omwe achotsedwa.
• Yambitsaninso foni pambuyo pake.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Kukonza kwathunthu:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• Chipangizochi chiziyambitsanso zokha (palibe chomwe chimafufutidwa).

Pitirizani?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Yambitsaninso Google misonkhano:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — yambitsanso kokha.
• Palibe chomwe chafufutidwa ndipo SUKUDZAtulutsidwa.
• Chipangizochi chiziyambitsanso zokha.

Pitilizani?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Limbikitsani kukonzanso (Matsenga Ofiira):

• Pazida zomwe zimanyalanyaza bokosi lakiyi lotayikira.
• Imagwira ntchito ngakhale makiyi ali abwino.
• Palibe deta yomwe yachotsedwa.

Pitilizani?
strings.confirmCertify:
Limbikitsani Play Store certification:

• Kuchotsa cache ya Masitolo okha — akaunti yanu sinakhudzidwe.
• Yambitsaninso, kenako tsegulani Sitolo.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER kukonza:

• Kuyambitsanso ntchito ya vendor.soter.
• Imachotsa SOTER data ya seva yokhayo.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Ikani chala (PIF):

• Imatembenuza custom.pif.prop ndikuyiyika munjira ya injini.
• Pamafunika kuyambiransoko pambuyo pake.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirmCanary:
Sinthani zala zala za Canary:

• Kutsitsa zala zaposachedwa za Canary kuchokera ku Google.
• Kulunzanitsa chigamba chachitetezo + kuyambiranso ntchito za Google (palibe kupukuta).

⚠️ Pamafunika intaneti (1-3 min). Pitirizani?
